scientific_integrity: Universal proof by exact symplectic intersection algebra and analytic branch inequalities; independent binary field graph enumeration and representative numerical checks supplement but do not replace the proof.
scientific_limitations: The classification is for positivity at every positive scale, not one fixed scale. The general polar association eigenmatrix and Schoenberg equivalence are prior results; an equivalent older specialized threshold remains possible.
title: Sharp Gaussian distance-power positivity on rank-three symplectic dual polar graphs
